SELECT t1.id, t1.name, t1.product_id as productId, t1.is_product as isProduct, t1.parents_id as parentsId, t1.status, t1.fail_reason as failReason, t1.create_time as createTime, t1.create_user as createUser, COALESCE(children.count, 0) + 1 as childrenCount FROM biz_wish t1 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT parent_wish.id as parents_id, COUNT(child_wish.id) as count FROM biz_wish parent_wish LEFT JOIN biz_wish child_wish ON child_wish.parents_id = parent_wish.id AND child_wish.deleted = 0 WHERE parent_wish.parents_id = 0 AND parent_wish.deleted = 0 GROUP BY parent_wish.id ) children ON t1.id = children.parents_id
